definitions.explanation: The act of changing from one thing to another, such as switching systems, modes, or approaches.
Shifting one's mental focus or attitude, especially recovering from a setback.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The system switchover will be done late at night.

examples.japanese: {夏時間|なつじかん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The changeover to daylight saving time was implemented.

⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{切|き}り{替|か}えて⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}もう→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
